description: Full-funnel attribution: marketing UTM, friend referrals, WingPoint partner referrals. Server-side durable event recording with idempotency, carried through to Stripe checkout metadata.

friend_referral.reward: 50% off first payment (Stripe coupon REFERRAL50); referrer reward via process_referral_conversion

data_flow.trigger: Landing page load with UTM/referral query params
data_flow.action: captureUtmParams() reads URL, sanitizes, writes to sessionStorage with 'utm_' prefix. URL overwrites stored params (last-touch).
data_flow.storage: sessionStorage: utm_utm_source, utm_utm_campaign, utm_utm_medium, utm_utm_content, utm_utm_term, utm_referrer, utm_ref, utm_wp_ref, utm_wp_trust_name

data_flow.action: Creates/updates lead in db.leads; calls record_lead_capture() -> analytics._record_event('lead_captured')

Sanitizes UTM via _clean_utm(); creates user doc with utm_*, referrer, referral_code, wp_ref; resolves referral; sets is_wingpoint. (Design: record_signup_attribution() should be called here for signup_complete event.)

Builds Stripe checkout session with metadata {user_id, plan_type, billing_period, utm_source, utm_campaign, utm_medium, referrer}; sets client_reference_id=Rewardful referral_id; applies REFERRAL50 coupon if friend referral.

referral_codes.code_format: 4 chars from name (uppercase alphanumeric, padded with X) + 4 random alphanumeric = 8 chars

rules: cap length: 200 chars (UTM), 500 chars (referrer), 50 chars (referral codes, wp_ref)

reporting.funnel_join: lead_captured -> signup_complete on email; signup_complete -> purchase_complete on user_id

gaps.description: record_signup_attribution() exists but is not called from auth.py register endpoint. No signup_complete analytics event is created.
gaps.recommendation: Call record_signup_attribution() in auth.py after user creation (password + OAuth paths).

gaps.description: UserCreate model lacks utm_content and utm_term. Frontend captures them but they are dropped at the API boundary.
gaps.recommendation: Add utm_content and utm_term to UserCreate; persist on user doc.

gaps.description: LeadCapture model has utm_source/campaign/medium but not utm_content, utm_term, referral_code, wp_ref. Leads arriving via referral links or A/B creative variants lose that data.
gaps.recommendation: Extend LeadCapture model and record_lead_capture() with full attribution set.

gaps.description: Current scheme is last-touch only (URL overwrites sessionStorage). First marketing touch is lost if a later click occurs.
gaps.recommendation: Add first_touch_utm snapshot set once, never overwritten, for multi-touch attribution.

gaps.description: GA4 Measurement Protocol and Meta Conversions API server-side calls are not configured. Events recorded internally only.
gaps.recommendation: Add forwarding calls in analytics.py after _record_event() when ad platform credentials are available.

file_map.backend/tracking/utm_tracker.py: Core attribution logic: clean_utm, resolve_signup_source, extract_utm_params, record_signup_attribution, build_checkout_metadata, get_attribution_summary
file_map.backend/routers/leads.py: Lead capture with source enum and scoring
file_map.backend/routers/subscriptions.py: Checkout metadata, Stripe webhook purchase recording, referral conversion
file_map.backend/routers/referrals.py: Friend referral program: code generation, Stripe coupon, conversion rewards
